comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep compile test strict for required wrist modules**

Guarding compilation behind `if path.exists()` weakens this regression test by allowing missing wrist entrypoint/split modules to pass silently. The purpose of this check is to ensure all expected source files are present and syntactically valid; with the existence guard, accidental file removal or path drift is no longer caught.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
